Line 12a boxes checked 0. Standard Deduction Worksheet: line 1 15,750.00; line 4 15,750.00; line 5 0 x 2,000.00 = 0.00; line 6 15,750.00. Line 15 0.00 (no Schedule A); line 16 15,750.00. Line 17 = 54,000.00 - 15,750.00 = 38,250.00. Line 18 federal Form 1040 lines 13a and 13b taken as 0.00; line 19 Idaho taxable income 38,250.00. Line 20 worksheet: line 1 38,250.00; line 2 4,811.00; line 3 = 33,439.00; line 4 at 5.3%; line 5 tax = 33,439.00 x 5.3% = 1772.267, to the cent 1,772.27 (the return rounds to whole dollars, PDF p.8, and shows 1,772; expected keeps the formula).
